text:
Alex Chen: Quick ping — I'm kicking off a PR to refresh the Quickstart (hello-world app + auth setup + first deployment). I rewrote the Node + Python SDK snippets for v2 and swapped the auth example to service tokens. Can folks glance at the code samples and the auth step order? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4824

DocsBot: PR created by Alex Chen — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4824 · Status: draft

Maria Gomez: Thanks Alex. Two quick Qs: 1) is the service token flow the recommended path for new users? 2) where do we show rotating keys/policy?

Alex Chen: Good Qs. Intent is: for quickstarts we want the simplest non-interactive path (service token) and a short note pointing to the security guide for rotation/KMS. I'll add a link but need the wording checked.

Jamie Park: I reviewed the snippets. A couple of tiny suggestions:
- In the Node snippet we should use `client.chat.completions.stream` instead of the old `streamResponses` call.
- For the curl example add the `--header "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY"` line so it's explicit.

Jamie Park: Proposed Node snippet for the readme:
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const stream = await client.chat.completions.stream({
  model: 'gpt-medium',
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Hello world!' }],
});
for await (const chunk of stream) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.text);
}
```

Jamie Park: And Python: 
```py
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
with client.chat.completions.stream(model='gpt-medium', messages=[{'role':'user','content':'Hello world!'}]) as s:
    for chunk in s:
        print(chunk.text, end='')
```

Maria Gomez: These look great. One wording nit: under "Create a service token" we currently show a web console flow. For CLI-first users we should show `redwood tokens create quickstart --scopes=generate` (or similar). Can we keep both?

Kevin Li: Quick note: the existing link to the private deployment guide (docs/enterprise/private-deploy) 404s for some readers — last I checked we renamed that page. We should update to /docs/private-deploy/vpc. Also add a short callout that private deployments require extra auth steps (KMS/HSM).

Alex Chen: Good catch Kevin — I'll swap the link and add the callout.

Sahil Rao: I can add a small CI job that runs a smoke test against the snippets (run node and python examples with a sandbox key) so we don't break them on future edits. Suggest GH Action: .github/workflows/snippet-smoke.yml that runs on PRs to docs. Want me to add to this PR?

Alex Chen: Please do, that'd be awesome. Make it opt-in for draft PRs so we don't pollute runs.

Jamie Park: One more thing — the auth section still mentions "API key" in a few spots where we should be explicit: service token vs user API key. Suggest a short table: use-case -> recommended credential.

Maria Gomez: Agreed. Also can we add a tiny paragraph about least-privilege scopes for quickstart tokens (only generation scope).

DocsBot: Linking checklist for PR reviewers:
- [ ] Node snippet uses `chat.completions.stream` (Jamie)
- [ ] Python snippet uses `chat.completions.stream` (Jamie)
- [ ] Curl example has explicit Authorization header (Jamie)
- [ ] Service token CLI example added + web console (Maria)
- [ ] Update private deploy link & note about KMS (Kevin)
- [ ] Add GH Action smoke test (Sahil)
- [ ] Add credential recommendation table (Jamie/Maria)

Kevin Li: I'll jump in on the KMS line and confirm the URL rename.

Alex Chen: Thanks everyone — I'll update the PR with the link and wording fixes. @Sahil ping me when you open the GH Action and I'll re-run the doc checks. :thumbsup:

Maria Gomez: LGTM for content direction — will do a lightweight prose pass after the snippets land.

Sahil Rao: Opening GH Action as a follow-up branch now. Will link back here when done.

Alex Chen: Closing loop — updated PR with changes per feedback and a short note in the quickstart header about "for production use follow the security guide". Ready for formal review when CI runs.

Jamie Park: Reviewing now. :eyes:

DocsBot: PR status: checks queued (snippet-smoke, lint).

Alex Chen: Thanks all!
